relations: If droplets descend and impact the pool center, bright columns rise and pinch off into new falling blobs.
When impacts occur, expanding concentric ring ripples and outward-growing crown-like splash rims form and subside.
As rising columns pinch off, stacked blobs form above the pool and fall back toward the star-shaped center.
caption: The video captures a high-speed macro view of luminous orange liquid against a black field of out-of-focus bokeh dots, with a glowing star-shaped pool in the lower center. A bright droplet-like blob is already suspended above the pool, hovering over a bright ring and a small secondary blob. Glowing droplets descend toward the pool center while bright columns rise from the craters, sometimes pinching off into new upper blobs that fall again. The pool surface shows expanding concentric ring ripples and crown-like splash rims that grow outward and subside between impacts. At times two stacked blobs appear above the pool, one above another. The star-shaped pool outline stays broadly in view, and the active splash at the center persists.
